title: GitOps cluster
description: GitOps entry point of one cluster in gitops/clusters/<cluster>/cluster.yaml. The argocd component makes one Argo CD Application for each component in the lists.

name.description: Cluster name. Must be equal to the folder name, and to the name of the Terraform instance in instances/.

infrastructure.description: Components in gitops/infrastructure/ that the cluster uses.

apps.description: Applications in gitops/apps/ that the cluster uses.

name.description: Folder name of the component. It is also the name of the Argo CD Application.

dependsOn.description: Components that must be Healthy before Argo CD syncs this component. The names can be in infrastructure or in apps.
